_help: Online content for the shop. Prices that players pay are set in Google Play Console; 'regular' and 'deal' here are only shown in the test version. A crossed-out price is always worked out by the game from the real Google Play prices (regular product, or 4 x VIP Weekly) and cannot be set here. Sales: at most 8 days, at least 30 days apart, or the game ignores them. 'ribbon' is the red label on a card (for example change RECOMMENDED to MOST POPULAR once sales data shows it); 'badge' and 'note' are the small tags. To add a new 70% OFF offer: add its item with 'dealSku' = a Play product at 30% of the regular price.

luxury._help: Luxury items. You can change an item's name, desc (words), price (in rupees: 4000000000000 = ₹4 Lakh Crore, 1000000000 = ₹100 Crore), bonus (% more profit for all businesses) or rank (the big title that opens it: Kharabpati, Neelpati, Padmapati or Shankhpati; empty = from stage 8). You can add a new item only with a picture that is already in the game ('pic': the id of an existing item, e.g. 'island'). Items are never removed from players. Wearables and homes always stay in the first collection.
